root_cause: Each poll set section loading=true even when valid data was already rendered.
Live WebSocket events and scheduled refreshes could overlap.
The page-level loader interpreted background work as an initial load and replaced stable content.

before.background_refresh: blocking loading state could replace content
before.refresh_failure: risk of obscuring last known state
before.visible_refresh_frequency: could flash on every background request

after.initial_load: blocking skeleton only when no previous data exists
after.background_refresh: last rendered data remains visible with non-blocking Updating status
after.refresh_failure: last known data remains visible with error/stale state
after.websocket_auth: token sent as first WebSocket message, not in URL; connected state waits for server acknowledgement
